result.rationale: The migration inserts old setting values verbatim via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's before_validation scheme/path stripping. EmbeddableHost.record_for_host matches via `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, comparing bare hostnames. The removed tests show settings could legitimately contain 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' — these would be stored with scheme/path and never match the bare-host lookup, breaking embeds for migrated sites.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill inserts each line from the old `embeddable_hosts` site setting directly via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips scheme and paths. Later lookups (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`) parse the referer URL and query by bare `uri.host` (`where("lower(host) = ?", host)`), so any migrated rows stored as `http://...` or with `/path` will not match and will cause `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` to return false (leading to `invalid referer host`).
